title: Find Root of a Colored Tree
statement: Given an undirected tree (n up to 10^5, degrees at most 3) with nodes colored R, B or W, the task is to find a root where every node has at most two children and each depth shares one color, cycling R->B->W. The color step forces every edge's direction, so the root is the unique in-degree-zero node; the degree cap leaves only the root's degree to check.
